entries.title: Genesis 33:1
segments: ¶Now Jacob lifted his eyes and looked, and there, Esau was coming, and with him were four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.

entries.title: Genesis 33:2
segments: And he put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.

entries.title: Genesis 33:3
segments: Then he crossed over before them and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

entries.title: Genesis 33:4
segments: But Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.

entries.title: Genesis 33:5
segments: ¶And he lifted his eyes and saw the women and children, and said, "Who [are] these with you?" So he said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."

entries.title: Genesis 33:6
segments: Then the maidservants came near, they and their children, and bowed down.

entries.title: Genesis 33:7
segments: And Leah also came near with her children, and they bowed down. Afterward Joseph and Rachel came near, and they bowed down.

entries.title: Genesis 33:8
segments: Then Esau said, "What [do] you [mean by] all this company which I met?" And he said, "[These are] to find favor in the sight of my lord."

entries.title: Genesis 33:9
segments: But Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself."

entries.title: Genesis 33:10
segments: And Jacob said, "No, please, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present from my hand, inasmuch as I have seen your face as though I had seen the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

entries.title: Genesis 33:11
segments: "Please, take my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough." So he urged him, and he took [it].

entries.title: Genesis 33:12
segments: Then Esau said, "Let us take our journey; let us go, and I will go before you."

entries.title: Genesis 33:13
segments: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children [are] weak, and the flocks and herds which are nursing [are] with me. And if the men should drive them hard one day, all the flock will die.

entries.title: Genesis 33:14
segments: "Please let my lord go on ahead before his servant. I will lead on slowly at a pace which the livestock that go before me, and the children, are able to endure, until I come to my lord in Seir."

entries.title: Genesis 33:15
segments: And Esau said, "Now let me leave with you [some] of the people who [are] with me." But he said, "What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."

entries.title: Genesis 33:16
segments: ¶So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 33:17
segments: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, built himself a house, and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

entries.title: Genesis 33:18
segments: Then Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which [is] in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan Aram; and he pitched his tent before the city.

entries.title: Genesis 33:19
segments: And he bought the parcel of land, where he had pitched his tent, from the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for one hundred pieces of money.

entries.title: Genesis 33:20
segments: Then he erected an altar there and called it El Elohe Israel.
